keep.text: Essays may be at most 4000 words.
Anything handed in after the deadline is late.

marking_md_rules.why: follows the out-of-date MARKING.md: at most 4000 words, late from the deadline itself, 50% to pass

pass_40.why: guesses the usual 40% pass mark instead of 43%

limit_under_4606.why: off by one: takes points off an essay of exactly 4606 words, though 4606 is fine and only 4607 is over

grace_60.why: a look-alike value: an hour's grace after the deadline instead of 61 minutes
